description: This PHP class defines an entity 'I18NError' for ORM mapping in Doctrine, representing error records related to internationalization (i18n) issues, such as placeholder mismatches and syntax errors. It includes constants for error types, properties for 'name' and 'message', and corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: I18NError
classes.description: Entity class representing internationalization error records in the database, with constants for different error types, and properties for error name and message.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name (type) of the i18n error.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name (type) of the i18n error.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the error message associated with this i18n error.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the error message for this i18n error.
